name: AWMC Championship
epitaph: The federation's top prize, changing hands seven times across 1999 alone, from a Hell in a Cell main event in January through a three-way dance in September.

name: AWMC Great Lakes Heritage Championship
epitaph: The federation's second-tier singles title, roughly equivalent to a United States or Intercontinental championship.

name: AWMC Extremist Championship
epitaph: The federation's hardcore title, changing hands eight times across 1999 before being retired and later revived.

name: AWMC Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The federation's tag team title, changing hands six times across 1999.

name: AWMC Motor City Championship
epitaph: A title created in August 1999 for the federation's less experienced roster, changing hands four times in its first five months.
